RCE Compile

Thirty percent of maximum-optimization builds never earn back their compile energy—unless positional caching cuts warm rebuilds 448 times.

[448.5x Rebuild Energy Cut · 0/500 Mix-Ups]

2/3 Maximum compiler optimization burns upfront chip energy that never pays back on up to thirty percent of programs.

3/3 Fingerprinting code by variable position reuses compiled builds safely, cutting warm Rust compile energy over four hundred times.
